svg.title: State feedback after a slug of water
svg.desc: After 0.01 cubic metres are poured into tank 1, the state feedback lowers the pump at once to 0.00889 cubic metres per second; tank 2 rises only 3.2 millimetres, peaking after 10 seconds, against 7.3 millimetres after 26 seconds with the pump left alone.
svg.text: State feedback after a slug of water
Control Studio recording of this project · 0.01 m³ poured into tank 1 of both cascades · numbers answer the predictions
With feedback: 3.2 mm, peak at 10 s
Pump drops to 0.00889 m³/s at once and never clips
